standard.summary: 控制 reference strength 随 denoising 时间变化。off 关闭调度；early_lock 在高噪声阶段更强；mid_edit 在中段更强；mask_preserve 保留低噪声尾部约束。
standard.effect: 早期高噪声阶段更影响构图和姿态，后期低噪声阶段更影响纹理和细节。schedule 可以避免全程强注入导致编辑失效，也避免完全不注入导致漂移。
standard.whenToUse: 训练 Edit-LoRA 时想保持 source 结构，又允许 target 指令改变局部内容或风格。
standard.avoidWhen: 只是普通 LoRA 训练或没有 reference latent 时保持 off。

optionDescriptions.early_lock: 高噪声（搭结构）时参考更强，版式/身份锁得死。
optionDescriptions.mid_edit: 中段参考更强，编辑落在语义段。
optionDescriptions.mask_preserve: 低噪声尾巴还拽着，细节不易漂，改幅也可能变小。

standard_en.summary: Varies the reference strength over denoising time. off disables the schedule; early_lock is stronger at high noise; mid_edit is stronger in the middle; mask_preserve keeps a constraint on the low-noise tail.
standard_en.effect: The early high-noise stage affects composition and pose most, the later low-noise stage texture and detail. A schedule avoids both strong injection throughout (which defeats the edit) and no injection at all (which lets things drift).
standard_en.whenToUse: When training an Edit-LoRA and you want the source structure kept while the target instruction changes local content or style.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Keep it off for ordinary LoRA training or when there is no reference latent.

optionDescriptions.off: Reference strength does not vary with time.
optionDescriptions.early_lock: Stronger reference at high noise (while structure forms), locking layout and identity firmly.
optionDescriptions.mid_edit: Stronger reference in the middle, so the edit lands in the semantic stage.
optionDescriptions.mask_preserve: Still pulling at the low-noise tail: detail drifts less, and the extent of change may shrink too.

advanced.principle: runtime 将 timestep/sigma/flow 值归一为 0..1 phase。phase=1 表示高噪声结构阶段，phase=0 表示低噪声细节阶段。
advanced.intervention: edit_injection_strategy 消费 schedule 输出，而不是直接读取 raw timestep。
advanced.expectedImpact: 让保结构和可编辑之间有可控切换，减少 copy source 或大幅漂移两种极端。
advanced.tradeoffs: 不同模型族的 timestep 方向可能不同；需要 adapter 级校准后再做质量声明。

advanced_en.principle: The runtime normalizes timestep/sigma/flow values into a 0..1 phase. phase=1 is the high-noise structure stage; phase=0 the low-noise detail stage.
advanced_en.intervention: edit_injection_strategy consumes the schedule's output rather than reading raw timesteps.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Gives controllable switching between structure preservation and editability, avoiding the two extremes of photocopying the source or drifting wildly.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Timestep direction may differ across model families; calibrate at the adapter level before making quality claims.
